incumbents (step 1: each must be reprodu.pHRR: exp074 (data/v2/train_phrr_promote_c2.py, HGB on log1p, 10 features, 191 rows / 64 merged groups), 0.6113
incumbents (step 1: each must be reprodu.rule if round 9 / cr_round2 adopts first: If, before round 10 step 1 runs, the critic-approved outcome of round 9 or cr_round2 replaces one of these records, round 10 for that target is scored against the NEW record as incumbent (reproduced the same way), and the candidates below are unchanged. protocol: Identical to each incumbent: same rows, same groups, same eval_protocol repeated GroupKFold 5x10 seeds, pooled OOF per repeat, material (group) bootstrap 95% CI with eval_protocol.bootstrap_ci. Paired comparison per repeat on identical folds.

pHRR.what: HRC-proportional offset (Lyon & Janssens 2005, DOT/FAA/AR-05/14 Eq. 71: HRR = eta_c * f(q_net)). base b(x) = ln(mcc_peak_hrr_Wg) (at FSRI's fixed MCC heating rate the peak is proportional to eta_c). Fit exp074's hgb() unchanged (learning_rate 0.05, max_iter 200, max_leaf_nodes 15, min_samples_leaf 10, random_state 0) on r = ln(y) - b(x) with the same 10 features (the peak stays a feature). predict = exp(m(x) + b(x)). Coefficient fixed at 1, never varied. log_target handled in the wrapper (ln, not log1p). Rows with missing mcc_peak_hrr_Wg: none expected (all exp074 rows have MCC); assert it.

Average on the ln scale of exp074's prediction (ln of expm1 output, clipped at 1e-6) and g1, then exp. g1 = physics-mean GP: GaussianProcessRegressor on r = ln(y) - ln(mcc_peak_hrr_Wg), inputs = the 10 exp074 features through SimpleImputer(strategy='median', add_indicator=True, keep_empty_features=True) -> StandardScaler, kernel ConstantKernel(1.0) * RBF(length_scale=np.ones(d)) + WhiteKernel(1.0), normalize_y=True, n_restarts_optimizer=0, random_state=0; predict exp(b + mu_GP).

pHRR.role: report-only (in the family for K, never selectable)
pHRR.what: the GP g1 alone, as defined in r10_phrr_g2

exp074 recipe unchanged with two added features: mcc_t_end_C = per-material mean of mcc_extras_fsri.csv t_end_bc_C (T95%), and mcc_fgc_JgK = fire growth capacity (FAA DOT/FAA/TC-20/35 Eq. 9): T1 = mean t_onset_bc_C + 273.15, T2 = mean t_end_bc_C + 273.15, T0 = 298 K, Q = max(mean total_hr_bc_kJg, 0) * 1000 J/g, FGC = Q/(T2-T1) * (T2-T0)/(T1-T0); NaN if T2 missing or T2 <= T1. Self-test before labels: the report's PC/ABS example (Q = 29.3 kJ/g, T1 = 695 K, T2 = 837 K) must give 280 +- 2 J/g-K. Means are taken over the same rows/aggregation the incumbent uses for mcc_t_onset_C.

FIGRA.what: the exp119 recipe (equal average of HGB log1p, ExtraTrees 500/min_samples_leaf 2, Ridge alpha 10 with impute+indicators+scaler; all exactly as train_blend_round1.py) on exp119's 9 features plus mcc_t_onset_C, mcc_t_end_C and mcc_fgc_JgK (definitions as r10_phrr_f1; if mcc_t_onset_C is already among the 9 features it is not duplicated). 12 features max.

Char Residue.what: equal average of the three exp117 members (HGB, ET, Ridge, unchanged) and g1, i.e. 4 equal weights. g1 = physics-mean GP on r = y - base, base = row-wise nanmean(sta_res_3K, sta_res_10K, sta_res_30K) (the cr_round2 o1 base, coefficient 1); where all three are NaN, base = in-fold training median of y. GP inputs = exp117's 11 features via SimpleImputer(median, add_indicator=True, keep_empty_features=True) -> StandardScaler; kernel and settings as r10_phrr_g2; predict base + mu_GP. No clipping (exp117 precedent).

exp117 blend with its HGB member replaced by the same HGB plus monotonic_cst = +1 on sta_res_3K, sta_res_10K, sta_res_30K and mcc_char_yield_pct, 0 elsewhere (sklearn 1.7.1 HGB accepts NaN with constraints). ET and Ridge members unchanged.

LOI.what: Avg(RF_m, ET_m, Ridge) where Ridge is exp115's Ridge member unchanged and RF_m / ET_m = make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy='median', add_indicator=True, keep_empty_features=True), <exp115's RF / ET with identical hyperparameters> + monotonic_cst c), c = +1 for total_fr_wtpct and el_P, 0 for every other column including indicator columns.
m1 without monotonic_cst (separates imputation from constraint)

exp115 recipe with 8 extra columns from skrub.StringEncoder(n_components=8, random_state=0) (skrub 0.10.1 in .venv312) on the row's FR-name string (fr_names; NaN -> 'none'), fit inside each training fold only and applied to that fold's test rows. RF/ET/Ridge settings unchanged. If skrub.StringEncoder is unavailable in 0.10.1 or needs a download, s1 is BLOCKED (FLAG), never substituted.

adoption: experiments/configs/adoption_gate_v2.json (D1 as amended: no human override; re-proposal bar) applied per target, family = every round-10 candidate of that target in the order listed (report-only members count in K, never selectable). Select the selectable candidate with the best repeated-GKF mean; then it must pass G1 (>= 8/10 paired wins), G2 (repeat-0 ci_lo >= incumbent's reproduced ci_lo) and G3 (studentised max-T paired group-bootstrap lower bound > 0, implemented by data/v2/adoption_gate.py). Adoption then still needs a fresh-context critic pass before numbers_of_record.json changes (orchestrator only).

honesty_notes: No fire-specific published evidence validates MCC/TGA-to-cone models under material-grouped hold-out; the physics relations are verified (FAA AR-05/14 Eq. 71; TC-20/35 Eq. 9) but their ML benefit is generic small-data evidence (Zhang & Ling 2018; Ramakrishnan 2015; Sarmiento 2026).
